COMPLICATIONS OF FOOD POISONING
Complications
Variable depending on cause and severity.:
- Fluid and electrolyte derangements, Dehydration
- Rectal prolapse.
- Protein-losing enteropathy, Malnutrition
- Haemolytic-uraemic syndrome
- Toxic megacolon, perforation
- Bacteraemia, Cholecystitis, Pancreatitis, Cystitis, Meningitis,
Endocarditis, Arthritis, Peritonitis, Cellulitis or Septic abortion
